findings.details: Hourly02 readme header states UPDATED: 2017-07-06. Corrected bibliographic year from 2026 to 2017, preserving stable source ID.
Marked access year explicitly for USCRN measurements and instruments, Argo profile guidance and undated Mauna Loa photographs.
The article now links separately to Data from GDACs and the profile-file guide. A guide is no longer labelled as the data itself.
Kept the original archival record and added a verified complete original PDF with 60 manuscript images and two introductory archive pages.
Verified edition M210566EN-K, December 2013, 209 PDF pages. Printed p.169 is PDF p.171.
